sources.name: Dog Aging Project 2025 Curated Data
sources.notes: HLES contains 200+ questions and the behavior survey includes excitability, aggression, fear/anxiety, attachment and trainability. Curated data are de-identified. Geographic identifiers are deliberately restricted. Do not download or train until the current DAP data-use terms and intended Woof use have been approved.

sources.name: Animal Kingdom
sources.notes: Dataset reports 50 hours of annotated video, 30K video sequences, 33K pose frames and 850 species. Use only as representation pretraining or auxiliary supervision, never as pair-compatibility labels.

sources.name: SyDog-Video
sources.notes: Paper reports 500 synthetic videos x 175 frames (87,500 frames), 33 keypoints and domain randomization across lighting, backgrounds, camera, appearance and pose. The paper demonstrates synthetic pretraining can help small real dog pose datasets. Treat this as precedent for Woof simulation, not evidence that synthetic compatibility labels transfer.

sources.name: DECADE (Dataset of Ego-Centric Actions in a Dog Environment)
sources.notes: Pairs first-person dog video with corresponding movement and IMU-derived joint/body signals. Useful for motion representations if current data availability and rights are verified.

sources.name: Animal Pose / Cross-Domain Adaptation for Animal Pose Estimation
sources.notes: Useful as a pose/domain-adaptation prior. High-confidence pseudo-labeling can expand dog-specific unlabeled data, but pseudo-labels must never become meetup-outcome labels.

sources.name: EthoCLIP / AnimalBand
sources.notes: CVPR 2026 paper reports AnimalBand with 74,671 videos and ontology-enhanced behavior pretraining. Treat as a strong future encoder candidate only after code/data/checkpoint release and rights are verified.

sources.name: Animal-CoT
sources.notes: Repository reports 8,220 structured video/text reasoning pairs across CBVD-L and KABR-L and uses Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct LoRA. The repository license does not automatically relicense underlying CBVD/KABR media. Prefer distillation into compact behavior features over serving a large VLM in the critical compatibility path.
